title: Basement membrane turnover controls cell shape.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed both repositories via API. UCL Research Data Repository (figshare) 10.5522/04/32647191, CC BY 4.0: FluorescentTimerCollagenIV_DataAndCode.zip = 78,426,690,123 bytes (~78 GB) and TissueMechanicsModel_Code.zip = 30.7 MB. Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20719515: a 4.3 MB GitHub snapshot of simulation code (CC BY 4.0). Did not download the 78 GB zip, which is far over the 50 MB cap.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only (Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500; supplement endpoint gave no zip). Content of the data is assumed from the abstract: fluorescent-timer microscopy images of collagen IV in Drosophila tissue, plus mathematical-model and molecular dynamics code.

a1_downloadable.note: Open download, CC BY 4.0, no login; checked file listing on UCL figshare.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No tabular label exists; the data is a 78 GB archive of raw microscopy and code, so any target (collagen IV lifetime, cell shape) would have to be built by image analysis. Seen only from the file listing, not the files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be raw images needing segmentation and fluorescent-timer ratio extraction; no feature table listed.

a4_units_stated.note: No table to check; not verified.

a5_enough_rows.note: Mechanistic study of a few Drosophila genotypes (e.g. perlecan perturbation); likely tens of tissues imaged, not thousands of labelled examples. Count not verified.

a6_fits_laptop.note: The only data file is 78 GB, far above the ~5 GB working-set limit and 50 MB download cap.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not check; full text unavailable and archive not opened.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any lifetime label would come from a physical fluorescent-timer measurement, not a model; but it would need to be computed.

honest_claim_h3: At most: from fluorescent-timer images of a handful of Drosophila tissues, predict local collagen IV age/lifetime — a single-lab imaging task with no labelled table.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use microscope images of a colour-changing collagen reporter in fruit-fly tissue to predict how long collagen lasts and resulting cell shape.
plain_idea.train_on: Raw fluorescence microscopy stacks from Drosophila tissues; number of images unknown, packed in one 78 GB archive.
plain_idea.predict: Collagen IV molecule lifetime or tissue cell shape, which would itself have to be computed from the images by ratio analysis and segmentation.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Matrix biologists could automate turnover measurement, but the paper is a mechanistic physics-biology study, not a dataset resource.

ml_idea: Image-to-turnover regression on fluorescent-timer collagen IV images; not viable without building labels from a 78 GB raw imaging archive.

effort.compute_note: Only estimated from the repository file size; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: File size of the data zip (78 GB), already checked.

verdict_reason: Only data is a 78 GB raw-imaging zip (A6) with no label column (A2); it is a small single-lab mechanistic Drosophila study, not an ML dataset.
